title: Infernal Coffin Awakening
description: A skeletal hand wearing an ornate golden gauntlet bursts from a broken wooden coffin in the foreground. Behind it, a massive flaming demonic skull with glowing eyes and sharp teeth hovers over a dark gothic cityscape filled with spires, clocks, and smoking chimneys under an orange full moon.
